notes: GAAP audit. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p7; row labels on p6). Fund balance roll-forward ties: 6,264,438 + 7,618,525 - 6,850,673 + 130,755 - 214,755 = 6,948,290. Ending cash = Cash and cash equivalents, Total Governmental Funds balance sheet (p5); CDs 1,277,152 in ending_investments; County treasurer cash 42,076 printed separately; no beginning cash printed. Internal service fund (governmental activities) is not in the governmental funds statements and is not recorded. Business-type: Water and Wastewater enterprise funds, Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position Total column (p9); 'Other revenue' 41,893 is counted in Charges for Services on the Statement of Activities, so charges for services; Grant income 488,929 (nonoperating, grantor not printed) recorded as intergovernmental with review; receipts total computed (operating + nonoperating revenues); disbursement total = Total business-type activities expenses 2,056,704 (p2). Roll-forward 6,390,035 + 2,515,251 - 2,056,704 + 84,000 = 6,932,582. Transfers: governmental in 130,755 (Infrastructure Improvement 85,755, Capital Projects 45,000), out 214,755 (General 22,500 net, Street 7,500, Grants 85,755, Infrastructure 99,000); net 84,000 to Water 91,500 / from Wastewater 7,500. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), component units excluded. Detail: General Fund from the Combining Statement of Revenues and Expenditures - General Fund Departments (pp17-18; more detailed than the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule p12, which is therefore not recorded); Street, Grants and Economic Development budgetary comparison schedules (pp13-15, budgetary basis, actual column; Grants is a major fund this year); nonmajor combining statement per fund (p16: Community Development, Keno, Infrastructure Improvement, Capital Projects). Debt Service and Aquatic Center funds have no schedule in the trimmed PDF; no business-type detail (as FY2023). Grants and contributions lines: grantor not printed, kept generic intergovernmental with review (user ruling 2026-11-12). Airport function uses the existing Airport category (printed function). Capital outlay detail lines have no object breakdown (not itemized); function only where printed or tied to a statement function; the Capital Projects Fund line is plain Capital Outlay.
